apiKeys.vault.ready: 데스크톱 앱이 키를 안전하게 저장하며, 로컬 AI 엔진을 다시 시작하면 적용됩니다.

language.description: 나중에 따로 바꾸기 전까지 UI 언어와 기본 응답 언어를 함께 맞춥니다.
themeDescription: 다크, 라이트, 고대비 운영 콘솔 테마를 전환합니다.
themeOption.light: 밝은 환경에 맞춘 종이 같은 대비입니다.
themeOption.highContrast: 가독성을 최우선으로 둔 AAA 수준 대비입니다.
densityDescription: Compact / Comfortable / Spacious — 모든 화면의 간격과 글자 크기를 조정합니다.
densityOption.compact.description: 간격과 글자 크기를 줄입니다 — 파워 유저나 큰 모니터 환경에 적합합니다.
densityOption.spacious.description: 간격과 글자 크기를 키워 장시간 작업 시 눈의 피로를 줄입니다.
deepLink.reauth.label: 외부 딥 링크 재인증

telegram.title: Telegram operator notifications
telegram.description: Reads the current workspace delivery snapshot when available and lets you keep a local desktop draft for digest cadence, timezone, and quiet hours.
telegram.localOnly: No dedicated RPC setter exists for these runtime files yet. Edits in this panel are stored only on this desktop.
telegram.timezone.invalid: Enter a valid IANA timezone such as UTC, Asia/Seoul, or America/New_York.
telegram.snapshot.title: Workspace snapshot
telegram.snapshot.chatDescription: The most recently updated chat is selected automatically when multiple preferences exist.
telegram.snapshot.empty: No Telegram preference files were found in this workspace yet.
telegram.snapshot.policyOnly: A delivery policy snapshot exists, but no per-chat Telegram digest preferences were found yet.
telegram.editor.title: Desktop draft
telegram.editor.description: This draft follows the existing config-store pattern. Use it to keep preferred values ready even before backend write APIs land.
telegram.editor.digestEnabledDescription: This mirrors the Telegram `/digest` preference at the renderer level until a dedicated write path exists.
telegram.editor.digestCadenceDescription: Choose how often the operator digest should be assembled for this local draft.
telegram.editor.digestIntervalDescriptio: Used only when the cadence is set to Interval.
telegram.editor.timezoneDescription: IANA timezone used for morning/end-of-day digests in this draft.
telegram.editor.quietHoursEnabledDescrip: Preserves a local quiet-hours window draft for Telegram delivery.
policyStudio.riskTier.title: Risk-Tier Matrix
policyStudio.riskTier.description: Operator-authored T0 to T3 tier drafts are saved independently from the action matrix and now feed runtime dispatch.
policyStudio.riskTier.emptyState: Policy snapshot is not available yet. Keep the runtime connected to load the current risk-tier matrix.
policyStudio.riskTier.diffDescription: Each cell compares the persisted matrix with the unsaved draft. Changed cells are highlighted and the preview tracks the backend impact summary.
